title: 第5章 假天才一年突破投名状第6章 二流武者玄清真气
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:
教训完赵虎那几个人，
陈默波澜不惊地回了屋，
前世毕竟是个三流武者，打几个连武者都不是的雏儿，实在没什么好得意的。
而接下来的日子，
陈默练得更狠了。
每天天不亮就起来，半夜才回屋。吃饭的时候都在琢磨运气路线，走路的时候都在比划招式。
外门长老们看在眼里，偶尔会夸两句“刻苦”“有毅力”。
但也仅此而已。
毕竟在外门，刻苦的人多了去了。能进紫衣门的，谁不想往上爬？
但陈默不一样。
他有玄清功。
这门功法虽然深奥难懂，但只要悟出一层，修炼起来比紫衣门的功法快得多。
一年后。
外门练功场上，陈默收功站定，长长吐出一口气。
体内的真气运转流畅，隐隐有突破之感。
他闭上眼睛，
引导内力走完最后一个循环。
轰，
脑海一声轻响，真气贯通。
三流武者。

陈默睁开眼，嘴角微微勾起。
一年。
比前世快了一二十倍！
相比前世，他现在不过十六岁，而这就是功法以及资质带来的改变！
他正想着，
身后传来一个声音：
“林默？你突破了？”
陈默转头，是隔壁屋的王顺，平时跟他关系还行。
“嗯。”
他点点头。
王顺眼睛瞪大：“我靠！一年就三流了？你小子可以啊！”
他的声音不小，
周围几个练功的弟子都看了过来。
“一年突破三流？”
“真的假的？”
“我记得他入门的时候测的是两经三脉吧？这资质能一年突破？”
“会不会是测错了？”
“测错个屁！你就慢慢羡慕吧！”
而消息很快传开了。
外门出了个一年突破三流的弟子，两经三脉的资质，叫什么林默。

一时之间，
不少人跑来围观。
“就是他？”
content_en:
After teaching Zhao Hu and the others a lesson,
Chen Mo returned to the house calmly,
After all, he was a third-rate warrior in his previous life, and there was really nothing to be proud of in beating up a few chicks who were not even warriors.
And the following days,
Chen Mo practiced harder.
I get up before dawn every day and don't go back to the house until midnight. While eating, I was thinking about the lucky route, and while walking, I was making moves.
The elders from the outer sect noticed this and would occasionally praise him for his "hard work" and "perseverance".
But that's all.
After all, there are many hardworking people in the outer sect. Who can enter the purple door and not want to climb up?
But Chen Mo is different.
He has Xuanqing Gong.
Although this technique is profound and difficult to understand, once you understand it at one level, you can practice it much faster than the Ziyi Sect's technique.
One year later.
On the outer training ground, Chen Mo stopped his exercises and stood still, exhaling a long breath.
The zhenqi in the body moves smoothly, and there is a faint feeling of breakthrough.
He closed his eyes,
Guide the inner energy to complete the last cycle.
Boom,
There was a soft sound in my mind, and my true energy penetrated.
A third-rate warrior.
Chen Mo opened his eyes and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.
One year.
One or twenty times faster than in the previous life!
Compared to his previous life, he is now only sixteen years old, and this is the change brought about by his skills and qualifications!
He was thinking,
A voice came from behind:
"Lin Mo? Have you made a breakthrough?"
Chen Mo turned around and saw Wang Shun in the next room. He usually had a good relationship with him.
"Yeah."
He nodded.
Wang Shun's eyes widened: "Holy crap! You've been ranked third-rate in just one year? You kid can do it!"
His voice is not quiet,
Several disciples practicing around him looked over.
"Breaking through to the third level in one year?"
"Really or not?"
"I remember he tested the two meridians and three meridians when he started, right? Can this qualification be broken through in one year?"
"Could it be that the test was wrong?"
"The test was wrong! You just need to be envious!"
And word quickly spread.
There was a disciple from the outer sect who broke through to the third level in one year. He had qualifications in two meridians and three meridians. His name was Lin Mo.
for a while,
Many people came to watch.
"That's him?"
